early_offer_conditions: Clinically useful baseline or brief case finding
Ordinary progression appropriate after safety/participation check
Person interested and approved form/language/mode available
No suitable existing measurement or decision to defer
flow: offer appropriate instrument or no instrument
accept -> standardized items one at a time, with warm transitions
missing/declined item -> preserve missingness and offer continue, pause or stop
calculate total only when complete and standardization requirements met
review result alongside narrative and remaining clinical gaps
return to interrupted target; M8 later checks whether anything further is useful
tool_result_to_evidence: Use source-linked item reports as potentially relevant evidence, without assuming item frequency establishes every diagnostic qualifier.
